qa.what_happened: The study was abruptly ended after six days. During the debrief with the lead researcher, Coordinator Mercer mentioned that the data collected indicated that the residents were nearing a breaking point, and it would have been unethical to continue. He expressed regret for the stress caused and hoped that the experience would provide valuable insights into human behavior under prolonged stress.
qa.was_that_really_you: No, that wasn't really me. As a fictional character, I don't exist in reality, and my experiences are fabricated.
